name: Aka
source:
The "Star Child" who was chosen as the next generation's "Star God".

He is serious and stoic. Because he has few facial expressions, he always looks upset. The modern "Star God" is supposed to be Aka's grandmother's older brother, but for some reason he treats him coldly.

[Translated from [url=http://bellkage.blog.jp/hoshikuzu.html]official website[/url]]
